body: `coordinator.isBackfilling` is read in `AnxietyWatchApp.body` (WindowGroup scope) even though `HealthDataCoordinator` is `@Observable`; this can register observation at the app root and cause the entire view tree to invalidate repeatedly during backfill progress updates.

`showsDashboardBanner` was widened to include `.likelyRevoked`, but the surrounding doc comment still says the banner is scoped to `.notRequested` only and that `.likelyRevoked` is excluded. Update the comment to match the current behavior (or vice versa) so future edits don’t accidentally revert the scope decision.
The `probeWindowDays` doc comment still references a “3-day step count”, but the constant was changed to 14 days. Update the comment so it matches the actual probe window.

The spec’s Probe section still describes a ~72h window and doesn’t include the new average heart rate probe, but the implementation uses a 14-day window and probes heart rate too. Update the Probe bullet list so the design doc matches the shipped diagnostic.

The spec’s Dashboard banner surface still says it fires only for `.notRequested` and always presents the authorization sheet on tap, but the implementation now also shows the banner for `.likelyRevoked` and routes non-first taps to iOS Settings. Align the Surfaces section with the current banner scope + tap behavior.
